mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_tb (student_id, student_name, birth, school, address, address_detail, gender, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, created_at, grade_no, level_no, status_no, app_id, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{gender}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{gradeNo}, #{levelNo}, #{statusNo}, #{appId} #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select:
WITH latest_history AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY updated_at DESC ) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY) SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, s.gender AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel,
h.status_no AS status, h.reason,
-- 형제 여부 CASE WHEN COUNT(sb2.student_no) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isSibling
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN sibling sb ON sb.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN sibling sb2 ON sb.sibling_code = sb2.sibling_code
LEFT JOIN latest_history h ON s.student_no = h.student_no AND h.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_INSTANCE ci ON ci.class_instance_no = stu_class.class_instance_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON class.class_no = ci.class_no
-- 부모 정보 LEFT JOIN PARENT p ON p.student_no = s.student_no
WHERE s.center_no = #{centerNo}
GROUP BY s.student_no, s.student_name, s.school, grade.grade, l.level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail, c.center_name, s.entry_han_date, s.entry_book_date, s.created_at, h.status_no, h.reason, p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, sb.sibling_code, s.student_id
ORDER BY s.student_name;

WITH latest_history AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY updated_at DESC ) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY) SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, s.gender AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, s.created_at AS createdAt,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel,
h.status_no as status, sc.status as statusName, h.reason
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN latest_history h ON s.student_no = h.student_no AND h.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_INSTANCE ci ON ci.class_instance_no = stu_class.class_instance_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON class.class_no = ci.class_no JOIN STATUS_CODE sc ON sc.status_no = h.status_no
LEFT JOIN PARENT p ON p.student_no = s.student_no WHERE s.student_no = #{studentId}
GROUP BY s.student_no, s.student_name, s.school, grade.grade, l.level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail, c.center_name, s.entry_han_date, s.entry_book_date, s.created_at, h.status_no, h.reason, s.student_id, p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, sc.status;

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, CASE WHEN s.entry_han_date IS NULL THEN s.entry_book_date WHEN s.entry_book_date IS NULL THEN s.entry_han_date WHEN s.entry_han_date <= s.entry_book_date THEN s.entry_han_date ELSE s.entry_book_date END AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 2
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.user_code = #{userCode} )
ORDER BY s.id

WITH base AS (SELECT ta.student_id, cc.class_type, cc.class_name, u.user_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cc.class_key = t.class_key JOIN erp_user u ON u.user_code = t.user_code GROUP BY ta.student_id, cc.class_type, cc.class_name, u.user_name) SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, g.grade_name, a.hanclass, a.bookclass, a.hanteacher, a.bookteacher, (SELECT Max(sth.move_at) FROM erp_student_transfer_history sth WHERE sth.student_id = s.student_id) AS moveAt FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key OUTER apply ( SELECT hanClass = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.class_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '1' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), bookClass = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.class_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '2' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), hanTeacher = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.user_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '1' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, ''), bookTeacher = Stuff(( SELECT ',' + b.user_name FROM base b WHERE b.student_id = s.student_id AND b.class_type = '2' FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') ) a ORDER BY s.id;
mapper.update: UPDATE class_instance SET user_no = #{userNo} WHERE class_instance_no IN (SELECT ci.class_instance_no FROM student_class sc JOIN class_instance ci ON sc.class_instance_no = ci.class_instance_no JOIN class_code cc ON ci.class_no = cc.class_no WHERE sc.student_no = #{studentNo} AND cc.class_type = #{classType})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_transfer_history (student_no, from_user_no, to_user_no, class_type, transfer_reason, move_at, class_no, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentNo}, #{fromUser.userNo}, #{toUser.userNo}, #{classType}, #{transferReason}, #{classNo}, #{moveAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
mapper.select:
SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE TO_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE FROM_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym
